description: This file contains the implementation of grains related to stream reliability testing in Orleans. It defines grain state classes, grain classes for producer and consumer roles, and a grain for stream unsubscription. The code handles stream initialization, subscription management, message sending, and grain lifecycle events, with conditional compilation for generics support.

classes.name: StreamReliabilityTestGrainState
classes.description: Serializable class storing shared state information for stream reliability testing, including stream provider name, stream object, producer/consumer roles, and subscription handles.

classes.name: StreamReliabilityTestGrain<T>
classes.description: Primary grain class implementing stream reliability test logic, supporting both generic and non-generic stream types, managing stream subscriptions, message passing, and state transitions.

classes.name: StreamUnsubscribeTestGrain
classes.description: Grain class providing functionality to subscribe and unsubscribe from streams, mainly used for testing stream unsubscription behavior.

methods.name: OnActivateAsync
methods.description: Handles activation logic such as initializing stream subscriptions and state, depending on whether the grain is a producer or consumer.

methods.name: AddConsumer
methods.description: Allows adding a new consumer subscription to the stream.

methods.name: RemoveConsumer
methods.description: Removes a consumer subscription from the stream.

methods.name: BecomeProducer
methods.description: Designates the grain as a producer for the specified stream.

methods.name: RemoveProducer
methods.description: Removes producer role from the grain.

methods.name: SendItem
methods.description: Sends an item into the stream.

methods.name: GetLocation
methods.description: Retrieves the silo address where the grain is hosted.

methods.name: TryInitStream
methods.description: Initializes the stream object if not already set, based on stream ID and provider name.

methods.name: ReconnectConsumerHandles
methods.description: Re-establishes consumer subscriptions from saved handles, supporting both generic and non-generic streams.
